priority_items.title: Novelly: Penrhyn military presence 'being negotiated'; project 'is not a [US] military base'
priority_items.summary: In-window RNZ Pacific exclusive (17 Sep 09:35 NZST / 21:35 UTC): US Ambassador Jared Novelly says a military presence at the Omoka/Penrhyn port upgrade is 'all being negotiated,' then states the project 'is not a [US] military base.' Open to a COK-requested security deal; no discussions yet. Design-phase leftover (US$50m + NZ$17.5m). Complements 5 Sep CIN 'friendly port' leftover. Not a signed access text. Not FLASH. Do not inflate.
